judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The theatrical 'Ooooh, how can this be?', the breathless short urgent sentences, 'cowardly madman' and the terse imperative journal line 'Regain the [Thing] stolen by the Necromancer' are pure Nox; the hand-off to another sage to interpret writings fits the campaign's fetch chain.
